FILE.ROLE: HTTP 响应编码模块：将状态码映射为 RFC 标准状态文本，构建完整的 HTTP/1.1 响应（状态行+头部+正文），并通过连接对象发送字节序列

INTERFACE.NAME: http_status_text
INTERFACE.ROLE: 将 HTTP 状态码映射为 RFC 标准状态文本；支持 200/201/400/403/404/405/413/500/501，其他返回 "Unknown"

INTERFACE.SIGNATURE: int http_response_send(http_connection_t* conn, int status, const char** extra_headers, const void* body, size_t body_len)
INTERFACE.NAME: http_response_send
INTERFACE.ROLE: 构建完整 HTTP/1.1 响应：状态行→Date→Server→Content-Length→Connection:close→可选 extra_headers→空白行→可选正文；extra_headers 为 NULL 终止的 "Name: value" 字符串数组

INTERFACE.SIGNATURE: int http_response_send_html(http_connection_t* conn, int status, const char* title, const char* fmt, ...)
INTERFACE.NAME: http_response_send_html
INTERFACE.ROLE: 便捷函数：vsnprintf 格式化内容→snprintf 包装为 HTML→设置 Content-Type→委托 http_response_send 发送

INTERFACE.NAME: http_status_text
INTERFACE.ROLE: 将 HTTP 状态码映射为 RFC 标准状态文本；未知码返回 Unknown

INTERFACE.SIGNATURE: int http_response_send(http_connection_t* conn, int status, const char** extra_headers, const void* body, size_t body_len)
INTERFACE.NAME: http_response_send
INTERFACE.ROLE: 构建完整 HTTP/1.1 响应并排队到连接输出缓冲：状态行→Date→Server→Content-Length→Connection:close→可选 extra_headers→空白行→可选正文

INTERFACE.SIGNATURE: int http_response_send_html(http_connection_t* conn, int status, const char* title, const char* fmt, ...)
INTERFACE.NAME: http_response_send_html
INTERFACE.ROLE: 将 printf 风格格式化字符串包装为 text/html 响应并发送

INTERFACE.SIGNATURE: static int queuefv(http_connection_t* conn, const char* fmt, ...)
INTERFACE.NAME: queuefv
INTERFACE.ROLE: 静态辅助：vsnprintf 格式化到栈缓冲后委托 http_connection_queue_str
